connector.name: Console MCP Server
connector.registryDescription: The official MCP Server from Mia-Platform to interact with Mia-Platform Console
connector.summary: Hosted at console.cloud.mia-platform.eu over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package console-mcp-server. Access is granted through an authorisation flow, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the mia-platform account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: The record references an OAuth flow, so expect a browser consent step rather than a static key. Confirm the scopes on the consent screen before you approve.
